programme.desc: Everyone puts their differences aside to honor Don's sister. Lily opens up to JR about her past. Ryan invites the crew to yet another a lake house to make amends, but things go left when Kat shows up. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: The future of 9MAG hangs in the balance when Ryan drops a bomb on the crew, and Ashley leaves Don after a dirty video makes the rounds.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Sky enlists the crew to help with her fashion show in L.A., Miss Kitty and Young Bae talk about their fight, Alex surprises Donna, and Tatiana reaches her breaking point.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Ceaser reunites with an enemy, Krystal has a much-needed talk with her father, and Sky's twerk fashion show includes a surprise that sends Ceaser over the edge.
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew Runner Up For Mother Teresa Number 2

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Free jackets get in the way of Ceaser squashing his beef with Alex, Tokie refuses to accept peace between Tati and Krystal, and Sky plows ahead with Operation Mend Fences.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: After mending fences with Puma, Cease makes him a partner at 113th only to have his decision be questioned during his 40th birthday celebration. Bae struggles to keep her marriage together, while Sky confronts her son Des, about his recent behavior.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Walt brings his new girlfriend by the shop, which causes Donna to catch a flashback. Young Bae and Rob face difficulties in their marriage. Sky is at a crossroads with her relationship with Des.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Kit's mom passes away in D.C and the news rocks the shop. Donna and Walt duke it out over Jessica. Puma hires new girl London and Bae thinks he has a shady, ulterior motive.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Puma hires London to cover for Kitty which disrupts the precarious balance in the shop. Tati has a run in with the law and Donna faces a major financial setback. Puma tries to bring a little kumbaya to 113 but no good deed goes unpunished.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: In an effort to support Miss Kitty, Ceaser and the crew head down to Memphis, Tennessee so she can reconnect with her mother's roots. Krystal confronts Donna about her behavior during the lock-in. And Walt makes a serious go at standup comedy.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: The crew continues their stay in Memphis to pay their respects to Kitty's mom. London decides to throw a house party to promote the brand down south. Walt prepares to take his relationship with Jessica to the next step.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Ceaser has a new opportunity to expand Black Ink but not everyone is happy with the deal, leaving him to question where loyalties lie. Donna plans a girls' night that's full of rowdy surprises. Walt and Jess can't see eye to eye.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: An unexpected drug test has Tati freaking out. Sky announces a huge surprise. Quani makes a decision that shocks Puma. Rok airs out his dirty laundry - literally. And problems with the Brooklyn shop puts Ceaser on a collision course with the police.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Ceaser deals with the fallout of his arrest, and what it means for the Brooklyn shop. Alex and Donna try to get their mojo back in the bedroom. Bae confronts a shocking diagnosis. And Sky embarks on a new venture.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Donna brings up people in Brooklyn talking trash about the upcoming Black Ink, which sets Ceaser off on a spiral through the past. Walt tries to make amends with Jessica. Sky embarks on a new business adventure. And Bae receives a welcome surprise.
programme.sub-title: Nice Day For A Shotgun Wedding

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: After missing for a couple of weeks, Ted comes clean to Ceaser and Puma about why he's been so absent. Mike finally receives his long-awaited paternity test results. Jessica brings her son Xavier to meet Walt. Mike has a medical emergency.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: The Brooklyn shop is finally open and Ceaser throws a block party to celebrate the grand opening. After Donna gives Alex an ultimatum, things don't go as expected. Crystal has a new jaw and a new attitude. Bae finds out Tati is hiding a big secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fills in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.
programme.sub-title: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler into a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: Motor vehicle fatalities account for many of the cases that come into the morgue. Dr. G offers expertise as to how to get behind the wheel and not wind up on a steel table.

programme.title: I Shouldn't Be Alive
programme.desc: Linda Forney and her pet dog Cocoa Gin set off to explore one of the seven natural wonders of the Grand Canyon.

programme.title: I Shouldn't Be Alive
programme.desc: Two climbers and close friends are scaling an ice wall near Alaska’s Mount Johnson when Jim falls down and suffers some major injuries.

programme.title: I Shouldn't Be Alive
programme.desc: Seriously injured and stuck in the middle of bear country, two friends face a real fight to survive.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: Minutes to Live
programme.desc: An unconscious woman is bleeding internally. Doctors must quickly assess the problem, and convince a reluctant surgeon to take the case. A man with a 4-day erection needs extraordinary help. A woman arrives in the ER with a knife in her chest.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: Nothing's Working
programme.desc: A woman complaining of abdominal pain finds out that she's actually pregnant - but is she ready to be a mother?

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: Toilet Paper Eating Patient
programme.desc: A woman complains of stomach pains after eating toilet paper; an inmate has a 108-degree fever.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: Deep Trouble
programme.desc: An off-duty ER physician diagnoses his own critical illness while en route to the hospital; a visiting ER doctor is threatened while working at a remote hospital; a patient with ominous symptoms returns to the ER multiple times after a scuba diving trip.

programme.title: Almost Unsolved
programme.desc: When a charred body is found in the Rocky Mountains, the RCMP have no idea who is behind this vicious murder.

programme.title: Almost Unsolved
programme.desc: The unsolved, 20-year-old murder of an unidentified woman in Utah finally gets closer to being closed with the confession of a known serial killer and some advances in DNA technology.

programme.title: World's Most Evil Killers
programme.desc: Ed Gein murdered two women in the 1950s and was also a body snatcher. He would fashion items out of bones and skin.

programme.title: World's Most Evil Killers
programme.desc: In Cumbria, 2010 taxi driver Derek Bird took his gun and, in less than 24 hours, shot dead 12 people and injured 11 more. The callous killer only stopped when he had run out of ammunition, finally turning the gun on himself.

programme.title: I Shouldn't Be Alive
programme.desc: Four men fight for their lives against the very animals they have dedicated themselves to protect.

programme.title: I Shouldn't Be Alive
programme.desc: 5 young guys from Bozeman, Montana have got together for a back-country ski trip to celebrate New Year 2005.

programme.title: I Shouldn't Be Alive
programme.desc: In March 2002, when filming for a documentary they were making, 2 divers Melissa Armstrong and Captain David Tomlinson became stranded in the Pacific Ocean when their boat drifts away from them.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: Heart In Hand
programme.desc: A doctor opens a nurse's chest, and takes her heart in his hand, in a desperate effort to save her life. Swords, severed limbs and suspicious stories lead to confusion in the ER and things go totally nuts at the hospital during a Greek Festival.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: Cowboy Chaos
programme.desc: A deranged cowboy is drenched in sweat, saliva, and urine, and no one knows why; a metal rod is impaled into the side of a young woman's head; two teenage girls are dangerously short of breath – what have they been up to?

programme.title: Misión: Imposible III
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt se enfrenta cara a cara con un traficante de armas peligroso y sádico al tratar de mantener su identidad en secreto para proteger a su novia.

programme.title: Misión imposible 4: Protocolo fantasma
programme.desc: El FMI se cierra cuando participa en el bombardeo del Kremlin, lo que provoca que Ethan Hunt y su nuevo equipo se conviertan en rebeldes para limpiar el nombre de su organización.

programme.title: Misión imposible 5: Nación secreta
programme.desc: Ethan y su equipo se embarcan en su misión más imposible hasta ahora, erradicando el Sindicato, una organización internacional ilegal tan altamente capacitada como ellos, comprometida con la destrucción del FMI.

programme.title: Inmersión letal
programme.desc: Paul Walker y Jessica Alba esperan pasar unos momentos inolvidables buceando, pero se meten en un lío con un traficante cuando encuentran la carga ilícita de un avión hundido en este thriller submarino lleno de acción y sorpresas.

programme.title: Tirador
programme.desc: Decidido a probar su inocencia en una traición, Bob Lee Swagger se encuentra ahora en una tensa carrera contra todas las fuerzas de la ley de los Estados Unidos y contra una organización oscura que quiere verlo muerto.

programme.title: G.I. Joe: El origen de Cobra
programme.desc: Son los G.I. Joe, una fuerza de intervención de élite de alto secreto formada por los mejores agentes de todo el mundo. Después de que la malvada Cobra haya robado un arma secreta, los G.I. Joe deben impedir que Cobra sumerja al mundo en el caos.

programme.title: G.I. Joe: el contraataque
programme.desc: "Los héroes americanos más grandes" están de regreso y han sido culpados de un crimen atroz que no cometieron. Roadblock (Dwayne Johnson) dirige a un nuevo equipo en esta explosiva aventura.

programme.title: Tirador
programme.desc: Decidido a probar su inocencia en una traición, Bob Lee Swagger se encuentra ahora en una tensa carrera contra todas las fuerzas de la ley de los Estados Unidos y contra una organización oscura que quiere verlo muerto.

programme.title: El equipo
programme.desc: Un equipo de soldados llega al pie de una base de montaña y descubre que algo siniestro acecha en la niebla y las sombras.

programme.title: Estación zombi
programme.desc: Una desgarradora película de terror y suspenso zombi, que sigue a un grupo de pasajeros aterrorizados que se abren camino a través de un brote viral en todo el país.

programme.title: Cementerio de mascotas
programme.desc: Para la mayoría de las familias, una mudanza es un nuevo comienzo. Pero para los Creeds será el inicio del fin. Se han mudado al lado del lugar que los niños construyen con sus sueños rotos, el Cementerio de mascotas.

programme.title: Scream. Grita antes de morir
programme.desc: Luego de una serie de muertes misteriosas, un grupo de fanáticos de películas de terror se vuelven el blanco de un asesino enmascarado en este thriller exitoso del director Wes Craven, que reinventó el género del terror.

programme.title: Scream 2: grita y vuelve a gritar

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.sub-title: Summer Wells Disappearance: What Do The Parents Know? Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.sub-title: Sex Abuse Allegations Ruined My Run For Congress And My Relationship With My Daughter Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.sub-title: Discipline Video: A Daughter's New Accusations Against The Judge

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Heroin use among America's youth is plaguing some of the most prestigious & safest suburban towns. Dr. Phil sheds light on Simi Valley, CA, where residents are fighting a heroin epidemic. Dr. Phil talks to teens., parents & meets with Mayor Bob Huber.
programme.sub-title: Heroin In Suburbia: A Town Intervention

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.sub-title: Multiple Restraining Orders And Fake Births: What's Next? Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his work with a family ripped apart by accusations of child molestation. Father Jason agrees to take a polygraph test to prove his innocence. Tune in to find out the results and what's next for this family!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Quinn says his wife, Sara, smashed a glass door, putting several stitches in his head, and punched, slapped, and kicked him in the face. But why won't he leave her? Can Dr. Phil help mend this fractured family as he confronts Sara about the alleged abuse?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Stacy and her boyfriend are accused of burning her 3-year-old daughter with cigarettes. What will lie detector tests reveal? Plus, Christina's mother has called CPS on her four times for allegedly abusing her grandson. Are Christina's kids in danger?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Michelle thought she had a perfect marriage until Wade admitted to keeping a horrible secret from his wife. Little did she know this one revelation would be the tip of the iceberg. Dr. Phil continues the startling story of Wade and Michelle. Part 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.sub-title: My Wife Of 18 Years And Mother Of Our 4 Children Is Divorcing Me For A 26-Year-Old Kenyan Man She's Never Met

programme.sub-title: From Top TV Newcaster To Drunken Mom

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.sub-title: Time Is Running Out For Prison-Bound Dad: Did His Wife Blackmail Him Into Embezzling $300,000

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.sub-title: Dr. Phil Hollywood Walk Of Fame/My Mooching Mom Has 5 Months To Get A Life

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil's interview with death row inmate Rodney Reed continues. Reed's attorney, Bryce Benjet tells what he thinks happened to Stacey. Retired NYPD detective Kevin Gannon & criminologist Dr. Lee Gilbertson say they know who killed Stacey & how.
programme.sub-title: What Happened To Stacey? What The Evidence Shows Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.sub-title: My Daughter Went From Being A School Counselor With A Master's Degree To Losing Her Children & Living In An RV

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Kathi says son, Nico, 14, plays video games all day & charged thousands buying tokens. Nico attended only six days of school this year & when disciplined, Nico rages, curses & terrorizes. Kathi says he learned this behavior from his dad, Evo; Evo agrees.
programme.sub-title: Our Device Addicted Violent Teen Controls The House

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Trust has been ranked as the #1 crucial quality for a happy marriage. Deanne & Brian have been married for 12 years with four children between them. Now, due to alleged lies and infidelity, their family is torn apart and divorce is just a signature away.

programme.title: South Park: Korn's Groovy Pirate Ghost Mystery
programme.desc: Korn's Groovy Pirate Ghost Mystery: The boys are being plagued by the 5th graders and South Park is overrun by Pirate Ghosts. Nu-Metal band Korn must save the day! (Scooby-Doo parody). (S3, E10)

programme.title: South Park: Hooked on Monkey Fonics
programme.desc: Hooked on Monkey Fonics: The boys compete against a couple of home schooled kids in South Park's annual spelling bee. (S3, E12)

programme.title: South Park: The Red Badge of Gayness
programme.desc: The Red Badge of Gayness: Cartman bets the boys he can win a Civil War re-enactment leading the Confederates. When things don't go to plan it's time for a booze fuelled rampage! (S3, E14)

programme.title: South Park: Mr. Hankey's Christmas Classics
programme.desc: Mr. Hankey's Christmas Classics: Join Mr Hankey as he hosts his own variety show from infront of the fire in his sewer home. Features unusual holiday songs such as "Christmas Time In Hell". (S3, E15)

programme.title: South Park: Are You There God? It's Me, Jesus
programme.desc: Are You There God, It's Me Jesus: Cartman claims to be going through puberty, making the boys jealous, and Jesus promises a New Year's Eve spectacle - so books Rod Stewart to play Las Vegas! (S3, E16)
programme.sub-title: Are You There God? It's Me, Jesus

programme.title: South Park: Worldwide Recorder Concert
programme.desc: Worldwide Recorder Concert: The class visit Mr Garrison's hometown for a recorder concert, where they attempt to find the mysterious 'brown noise'. What part does Kenny G play in this? (S3, E17)

programme.title: South Park: The Tooth Fairy Tats
programme.desc: The Tooth Fairy Tats: Cartman gets $2 from the Tooth Fairy, which leads him to a scheme to buy a new videogame. It's not long before the boys are caught up in the black market tooth racket. (S4, E01)

programme.title: South Park: Cartman's Silly Hate Crime 2000
programme.desc: Cartman's Silly Hate Crime: Things go from bad to worse for Cartman after he throws a rock at Token - it's jail time for this racist! Will the boys win the sled race without lardy on board? (S4, E02)

programme.title: South Park: Timmy 2000
programme.desc: Timmy! 2000: The boys copy Timmy's behaviour (who has ADD) in order to get out of doing homework. Timmy is heading for rock stardom - but not if Phil Collins has anything to do with it! (S4, E03)

programme.title: South Park: Quintuplets 2000
programme.desc: Quintuplets 2000: After seeing the Cirque Du Cheville the boys decide to start their own circus. The Romanian contorting quintuplets from the show want to stay in USA - can the boys help? (S4, E04)

programme.title: South Park: Cherokee Hair Tampons
programme.desc: Cherokee Hair Tampons: When Kyle falls ill his mum goes to Miss Information's holistic medicine store - can herbs supplied by 2 "native" Americans really help? Guest stars Cheech and Chong. (S4, E06)

programme.title: South Park: Chef Goes Nanners
programme.desc: Chef Goes Nanners: Chef and Uncle Jimbo go head-to-head over South Park's racist flag but the townsfolk aren't fussed either way. Will the flag be made PC? Not if the KKK have a say! (S4, E07)

programme.title: South Park: Something You Can Do With Your Finger
programme.desc: Something You Can Do With Your Finger: Cartman is convinced that his dream is a sign from God, so corrals the boys into making a boyband called "Fingerbang". He's not happy when Wendy joins! (S4, E08)
programme.sub-title: Something You Can Do With Your Finger

programme.title: South Park: Do the Handicapped Go to Hell? (Part 1)
programme.desc: Do The Handicapped Go To Hell? (1): The boys are convinced they will go to hell when they die unless they confess all their sins. Satan is torn between two lovers: Chris and Saddam Hussein. (S4, E09)
programme.sub-title: Do the Handicapped Go to Hell? (Part 1)

programme.title: South Park: Probably (Part 2)
programme.desc: Probably (2): The boys build a church-shaped shack to live in and listen to Cartman the preacher man. Meanwhile, Satan turns to an unlikely source for advice about his relationship woes. (S4, E10)

programme.title: South Park: Fourth Grade
programme.desc: 4th Grade: The boys enter the 4th grade and take a fast dislike to their new teacher, Ms Choksondik. Meanwhile, Mr Garrison realises he needs to acknowledge and confront his "gay side". (S4, E11)

programme.title: South Park: Trapper Keeper
programme.desc: Trapper Keeper: Cartman is none too happy when 'Bill Cosby' tells him his ultra-advanced Trapper Keeper 2000 is destined to become sentient and wipe out humanity. That kinda sucks ay? (S4, E12)

programme.title: South Park: Helen Keller! The Musical
programme.desc: Helen Keller! The Musical: The boys stage a Thanksgiving play about the life of author Helen Keller, starring Timmy as Helen. There's trouble involving his favourite turkey, Gobbles. (S4, E13)

programme.title: South Park: Pip!
programme.desc: Pip (a.k.a. Great Expectations): South Park's unusual version of the classic Dickens tale, featuring robot monkeys and the Genesis Device! Narrated in vision by Malcolm McDowell. (S4, E14)

programme.title: South Park: Fat Camp
programme.desc: Fat Camp: Cartman is sent to fat camp in order to resolve his weight problem but all is not as it seems when he returns skinny. Kenny gets his own TV show where he performs disgusting acts. (S4, E15)

programme.title: South Park: The Wacky Molestation Adventure
programme.desc: The Wacky Molestation Adventure: Kyle has his parents arrested so he can go to a concert but things get out of hand and it's not long before there are no adults left in town! (S4, E16)

programme.title: South Park: A Very Crappy Christmas
programme.desc: A Very Crappy Christmas: When Mr Hankey fails to show up at Christmas time the boys go looking for him in the sewers. Can the gang revive the spirit of Christmas with their own cartoon? (S4, E17)

programme.title: South Park: Scott Tenorman Must Die
programme.desc: Scott Tenorman Must Die: Cartman is tricked into buying pubic hair by Scott Tenorman. Outraged at being laughed at, he plots the most sickest, evil revenge possible... Radiohead guest star. (S5, E04)

programme.title: South Park: It Hits the Fan
programme.desc: It Hits The Fan: Swearing on a TV show leads to mass profanity in South Park. What does this have to do with The Black Death?! The you-know-what-hits the fan 162 times in this ep! (S5, E01)

programme.title: South Park: Cr***le Fight
programme.desc: Cr***le Fight: It's Timmy vs. Jimmy! But does Jimmy know this? The boys are joining the Scouts (troop 69) but their parents aren't so sure when they discover who the Scout Leader is. (S5, E02)

programme.title: South Park: Terrance and Phillip: Behind the Blow
programme.desc: Terrance and Phillip - Behind The Blow: The boys face death at the hands of some unhinged environmentalists unless they can re-unite Terrance and Phillip for a show at Earth Day Festival! (S5, E05)
programme.sub-title: Terrance and Phillip: Behind the Blow

programme.title: South Park: Cartmanland
programme.desc: Cartmanland: When Cartman inherits $1million and purchases his own theme park, Stan starts to question his faith in God. It's not long before things start to go out of control for Cartman. (S5, E06)

programme.title: South Park: Hotter than Summer: Proper Condom Use
programme.desc: Proper Condom Use: After Cartman and Stan play "red rocket" with their dogs, their parents decide it's time for some school sex education. What the school provides creates worse problems! (S5, E07)
programme.sub-title: Hotter than Summer: Proper Condom Use

programme.title: South Park: Towelie
programme.desc: Towelie: Stan's mother buys the boys a console called The Okama Gamesphere but it is stolen whilst they are at school. To get it back they must help a talking towel take on the government! (S5, E08)

programme.title: South Park: Osama Bin Laden Has Farty Pants
programme.desc: Osama Bin Laden Has Farty Pants: The boys send $1 to Afghan children and receive a goat back. When they try to return it an adventure ensues! First episode to air after 9/11. (S5, E09)
programme.sub-title: Osama Bin Laden Has Farty Pants

programme.title: South Park: How To Eat With Your Butt
programme.desc: How To Eat With Your Butt: It's school photo time. Kenny decides to play a prank by wearing his parka upside down and revealing his buttocks. Cartman decides to take it a step further. (S5, E10)
programme.sub-title: How To Eat With Your Butt

programme.title: South Park: The Entity
programme.desc: The Entity: Kyle's annoying cousin arrives in town and it's not long before the boys are doing their best to get rid of him. Mr Garrison invents a slightly sexual new mode of transport. (S5, E11)

programme.title: South Park: Here Comes The Neighbourhood
programme.desc: Here Comes The Neighbourhood: Token is picked on for being rich so decides to market the town as a millionaire's playground - cue Will Smith and Snoop Dogg moving in! Class war follows! (S5, E12)

programme.title: South Park: Kenny Dies
programme.desc: Kenny Dies: When Kenny is diagnosed with a terminal illness, Stan takes it especially hard. Will Cartman's truck load of foetuses help with a cure? Or does he have other plans for them... (S5, E13)

programme.title: South Park: Butter's Very Own Episode
programme.desc: Butters' Very Own Episode: Butters' mum asks him to spy on his dad, however what he discovers leaves Mrs Stoch acting slightly unhinged. Will this be the end of our lil blonde haired buddy? (S5, E14)

programme.title: South Park: Professor Chaos (Part 1)
programme.desc: Professor Chaos (1): Butters is sacked by the boys as their replacement best friend for Kenny - the hunt for a new friend is on! Out for revenge, Butters becomes... Professor Chaos! (S6, E06)

programme.title: South Park: Simpsons Already Did It (Part 2)
programme.desc: Simpsons Already Did It (2): Professor Chaos gets distraught as he realises all of his plans have already appeared on The Simpsons! Cartman gets very excited about growing Sea People. (S6, E07)

programme.title: South Park: Red Hot Catholic Love
programme.desc: Red Hot Catholic Love: A sexual abuse scandal involving priests hits South Park and is taken all the way to the Vatican. (S6, E08)

programme.title: South Park: Free Hat
programme.desc: Free Hat: Kyle, Stan, Cartman & Tweek get angry about Steven Spielberg and George Lucas' habit of altering their films with each "re-re-re-release". They go on a mission to steal the movies.(S6, E09)

programme.title: Los Hijos De Satanás
programme.desc: Tras una riña en una cantina por la disputa de unas tierras dos hombres se convierten en enemigos mortales e intentan a toda costa demostrar en su pueblo quien es el más fuerte.

programme.title: Juan El Desalmado
programme.desc: Juan, hijo de un indio y una blanca, pierde a sus padres a manos de una banda de desalmados bandidos comandados por un par de hermanos, quienes acostumbran a cambiar su nombre para despistar a sus seguidores.

programme.title: La Trinchera
programme.desc: Rómulo, mejor conocido como El Cascabel regresa a su pueblo en busca de su gran amada Maria, pero pronto se da cuenta que su reputación es la de un asesino ya que estuvo en la cárcel y quiere limpiar su imagen dejando atrás sus armas.

programme.title: El transportador 3
programme.desc: Frank Martin es un indiscutible especialista en entregas de alto riesgo. En esta ocasión está obligado bajo amenazas a trasladar dos voluminosas bolsas y una joven ucraniana desde Marsella hasta Odessa

programme.title: El Ocaso de La Luz
programme.desc: Un agente de la CIA descubre que está comenzando a perder la vista, y es muy probable que se quede completamente ciego. Mientras lucha con esta ceguera, tiene que enfrentarse a la última misión de su último trabajo.

programme.title: En el juego del Asesino
programme.desc: La policía detiene a un psicópata al que se le relaciona con múltiples raptos y asesinatos de mujeres, pero su captura será solo el principio de una cuenta atrás en busca de sus víctimas

programme.title: Agua Profunda
programme.desc: Black Water es una película de acción que gira en torno a un agente (Jean-Claude Van Damme) que despierta atrapado en una prisión secreta de la CIA a bordo de un submarino.

programme.title: Swelter
programme.desc: Diez años después de su atraco en el casino, cuatro convictos escaparon de su antiguo compañero a una ciudad desierta, donde ahora es un hombre de la ley sin memoria de su pasado criminal.

programme.title: Peligro en la montaña
programme.desc: Joe Braven es un humilde leñador que vive en la frontera de los Estados Unidos. Cuando es asaltado por un grupo de traficantes de drogas en la recluida cabaña donde vive, hará todo lo que puede para proteger a su familia.

programme.title: El transportador 3
programme.desc: Frank Martin es un indiscutible especialista en entregas de alto riesgo. En esta ocasión está obligado bajo amenazas a trasladar dos voluminosas bolsas y una joven ucraniana desde Marsella hasta Odessa

programme.title: Cuenta Regresiva
programme.desc: Un profesor universitario se encuentra con una serie de números encontrados en una cápsula de tiempo, y llega a darse cuenta de que han predicho cada desastre de los últimos 50 años.

programme.title: Agua Profunda
programme.desc: Black Water es una película de acción que gira en torno a un agente (Jean-Claude Van Damme) que despierta atrapado en una prisión secreta de la CIA a bordo de un submarino.

programme.title: El transportador 3
programme.desc: Frank Martin es un indiscutible especialista en entregas de alto riesgo. En esta ocasión está obligado bajo amenazas a trasladar dos voluminosas bolsas y una joven ucraniana desde Marsella hasta Odessa

programme.title: Planetarium
programme.desc: "Planetarium" sigue el viaje de hermanas que se cree que poseen la habilidad sobrenatural de conectarse con fantasmas. Se cruzan con un visionario productor francés mientras actúan en París.

programme.title: La Huésped
programme.desc: Un enemigo invisible amenaza a la humanidad apoderándose de sus cuerpos y borrando sus recuerdos. Melanie arriesgará todo para proteger a quienes le importan.

programme.title: Las Guerras Inmortales
programme.desc: Después de que una guerra catastrófica sume al mundo en el caos, surge una nueva raza de seres con superpoderes conocidos como "desviados".

programme.title: Daredevil
programme.desc: Un hombre cegado por unos residuos tóxicos, que también han potenciado el resto de sus sentidos, lucha contra el crimen como un acrobático superhéroe de las artes marciales.

programme.title: Elektra
programme.desc: Elektra tras recuperarse de las mortales heridas sufridas en "Daredevil", se convierte en la más peligrosa asesina del mundo.

programme.title: Jumper
programme.desc: David Rice es un Jumper, una anomalía genética con el poder de teletransportarse instantáneamente a cualquier lugar del mundo y descubre que existen otros como él.

programme.title: Lazarus
programme.desc: Un hombre es asesinado, pero su muerte es un asunto breve. Al recuperar la conciencia, descubre que ha sido dotado de poderes extraordinarios que le permiten luchar heroicamente contra la organización responsable de sumergir su ciudad en la oscuridad.

programme.title: Alien: Bellezas mortales
programme.desc: Luke y Roger son sólo otro par de universitarios tratando de perder su virginidad. Pero cuando Luke ve algo inusual, comienza a sospechar que las chicas del campus no son exactamente... humanas.

programme.title: Daredevil
programme.desc: Un hombre cegado por unos residuos tóxicos, que también han potenciado el resto de sus sentidos, lucha contra el crimen como un acrobático superhéroe de las artes marciales.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Tras su mudanza a una granja en Ohio, la familia Cain descubre que su idílico hogar está embrujado por los fantasmas de un brutal asesinato y un incendio mortal.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una familia se muda a una casa con una historia oscura y oculta y pronto se percatan de que no están solos. Los rituales oscuros y la muerte han atraído al mal a la casa y los niños son su objetivo.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando un implacable demonio amenaza con la vida de la familia Cupit, un equipo de investigadores paranormales y demonólogos luchan contra la fuerza del mal para obligarla a regresar al infierno.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una serie de eventos inexplicables dejan al descubierto una larga historia de muerte en torno a la nueva casa de los Yaple. Cuando la familia es atacada, buscan ayuda especializada antes de que el demonio que cambia de forma aumente su crueldad.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una familia descubre una habitación secreta en su nueva casa, enfureciendo a un fantasma que hará lo imposible para expulsarlos.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Durante su visita, la madre de Taylor abre la casa al mundo de los muertos, buscan ayuda de investigadores paranormales y descubren la atrocidad que ocurrió en el ático años atrás.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Anita y su hijo se enfrentan a un demonio que usa un antiguo artefacto para abrir portales en su casa.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una familia sospecha que alguien merodea su casa y descubre la presencia de un fantasma que murió trágicamente en la propiedad. La situación se torna violenta. ¿Podrá la familia recuperar su casa antes de que sea demasiado tarde?

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Tras un escalofriante encuentro con una momia egipcia, un joven es perseguido por el ente para robarle el alma.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una adolescente experimenta con el ocultismo y la oscuridad es atraída a su casa de Alaska. El espíritu ataca a la familia y, al ver que sus vidas peligran, buscan la ayuda de expertos.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una familia limpió la casa de un pariente mayor, pero las cajas no fueron lo único que llevaron a casa.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando un adolescente talentoso realiza una gira de fantasmas en Missouri, una entidad malvada lo sigue a casa. ¡Y cuando llegue las cosas al siguiente nivel, se dará cuenta de que necesitan ayuda y rápido!

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando Jennifer Patterson encuentra la casa de sus sueños en la zona rural de Indiana, está más que emocionada. Pronto, voces y aromas inexplicables la llevan a creer que la casa está encantada por el fantasma del dueño anterior.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Después de mudarse a una nueva casa, los Barbour se preocupan por el efecto negativo que un amigo imaginario está teniendo en su hija. Pronto se hace evidente que están lidiando con un fantasma enojado.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Un hogar es invadido por un demonio empeñado en lastimar a los miembros de la familia uno por uno.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando Jacinda Rearick encuentra orbes en sus fotos, cree que son espíritus amistosos. Pero cuando una entidad oscura comienza a atormentar a su familia, se da cuenta de que están lidiando con el mal.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Después de que Candace y John St. Clair exploran un túnel encantado con una historia espantosa, un invitado no invitado los sigue a casa.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una pareja se muda a una casa con una historia trágica y pronto cree que su casa está encantada. Después de varios ataques, piden ayuda a investigadores paranormales.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Después de que un amenazador soldado nazi busca venganza por su muerte y amenaza a una pareja inocente, buscan ayuda para hacer las paces con su fantasma.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una mujer cree que su difunto esposo está rondando su hogar hasta que su hija es atacada por una entidad maligna.

programme.title: Platillos Voladores
programme.desc: Marciano y Saturnina, van a un baile de disfraces con trajes interplanetarios. Al producirse una pelea entre el joven y un pretendiente de la muchacha a quien apoya su padre, la pareja escapa en un artefacto inventado por Marciano que es mecánico.

programme.title: Pobre Huerfanita
programme.desc: Virginia es una niña que lo tiene todo en la vida, menos el cariño de su padre que por tener tanto dinero se la viven de fiesta en fiesta, por lo que le brindan muy poco a casi nada de atención quedando siempre al cuidado de una institutriz.

programme.title: Que Hombre Tan Sin Embargo
programme.desc: Filomeno, es un hombre que llega a casa de Laura cuando mas lo necesita. El es un simple desconocido para Laura y su familia adinerada y de prestigio que por el momento pasa por una crisis financiera, ya que la industria de la sal estan en quiebra.

programme.title: El Águila Negra
programme.desc: Los hermanos Raul, Fernando, Armando y Manuel viven en rancho tranquilo con su nana; sin embargo, Armando y Manuel son asesinados en una pelea provocada por Ciriaco y Anselmo, esbirros del villano Moncada.

programme.title: Las Cenizas Del Diputado
programme.desc: Teodoro, candidato a diputado del pueblo de San Miguel de Bajo, pretende ganar las elecciones, por lo que organiza una corrida de toros donde actuara en favor de los pobres. El dia de la corrida, Teodoro y el cura del pueblo sufren un accidente.

programme.title: Los Santos Reyes
programme.desc: Los reyes, son tres hermanos que son encarcelados por el delito de robo, ellos planean su fuga. Ya libres, el trio va en busca de un botín que habían dejado oculto en el pueblo de matas verdes, donde se hacen pasar por médico, profesor y abogado.

programme.title: Tres Vivales
programme.desc: Tres hombres compiten por el amor de las tres mujeres más bellas del pueblo, las hijas del alguacil.

programme.title: Que Lindo Cha Cha Cha
programme.desc: El diablo, molesto porque Don Candido, el presidente municipal de un pueblo esta moralizando las costumbres del pueblo que gobierna, envia a uno de sus subordinados a la tierra para corromper el ambiente mediante la organizacion de un cabaret.

programme.title: Recien Casados... No Molestar
programme.desc: Catalina y Andres son una joven pareja a punto de casarse. Cada uno tiene su despedida de soltero con sus amigos y amigas respectivamente, donde intentan hacerles ver los pros y los contras del matrimonio con un poco de satira.

programme.title: Rumba Caliente
programme.desc: Ticha es una joven cuyo trabajo es ser vendedora de cigarros y dulces en el teatro, con el sueño de triunfar como actriz y ser como la Vedette Lily del mar quien trabaja en una de las obras exhibidas en el teatro.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Una apuesta iniciada porque Cartman vio a un duende es el inicio de un problema, aunado a que los chicos se encuentran frente a la totalidad imaginativa del mundo atacada por un grupo terrorista.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan y Kyle han sido capturados por el Pentágono para que le digan al gobierno exactamente cómo entraron a "Imaginaciónlandia". Mientras tanto, Cartman no se da por vencido en su apuesta con Kyle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: En "Imaginaciónlandia", Stan y Butters luchan contra un ejército de fuerzas imaginarias. La Suprema Corte declara que las criaturas imaginarias no son reales y planean destruir "Imaginaciónlandia".

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan y Kyle se obsesionan tanto con Guitar Hero que llegan al punto de romper récords, lo que hace que Stan considere llegar más lejos consiguiendo un compañero diferente.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Las chicas de cuarto grado han creado una lista secreta que posiciona a los chicos desde los más guapos hasta los más feos. Pero cuando ellos roban la lista, los resultados no son lo que esperaban.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Después de que una rutina de tonsilectomía sale horriblemente mal, Cartman se enfrenta cara a cara con su propia mortalidad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cuando los chicos ayudan a Britney Spears a llegar al Polo Norte, descubren el secreto impactante detrás de su popularidad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: En el homenaje de South Park a la película "Heavy Metal", los chicos tratan de que Kenny se libre de la última locura por las drogas que ha capturado a la escuela.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La cabeza de la Agencia Mundial de Canadá liderea al país a una huelga larga y dolorosa, la responsabilidad de llegar a un acuerdo depende de los chicos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Mientras la señora Garrison está tratando de encontrar una forma de convertirse en el hombre que siempre intentó ser, Cartman es puesto a cargo del salón de clases.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los residentes de South Park se despiertan sin internet. Randy se entera de que en California todavía hay internet, por lo tanto, junto a su familia deciden viajar al oeste del país.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Mientras los chicos hacen una visita educativa a un museo, Cartman obliga a Butters a que se escabulla de la clase para ir al centro de entretenimiento que está al lado.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Con el resto de los norteamericanos perseguidos por la memoria de un reciente evento trágico, sólo Butters se unirá con Cartman para confrontar a los chinos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Wendy se mete en problemas cuando amenaza a Cartman de darle una paliza después de las clases.
programme.sub-title: El show sobre el cáncer de seno

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cuando el mundo lucha por contener una epidemia de proporciones épicas, los chicos buscan la forma de sacar dinero de eso.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Puercos gigantes de Guinea están atacando a ciudades de todo el mundo. Los chicos tienen la clave que salvará a todos de un ataque pero están varados en los Andes.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: ¡Barack Obama en South Park! Los padres de los chicos celebran el triunfo de Obama, mientras el nuevo presidente no sabe qué hacer con el chiquero que Bush le dejó en la Oficina Oval.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Parodia de "High School Musical" como sólo South Park pudo hacerla. ¿Qué ocurre cuando un niño muy popular enamora a las niñas y le quita a Cartman, Stan, Kenny y Kyle toda la atención?

programme.title: South Park

programme.desc: El primo de Kyle, también llamado Kyle, llega de visita desde Connecticut, ya que su madre está enferma. A pesar de ser de la misma edad, los primos no tienen nada en común.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan y Kyle han sido capturados por el Pentágono para que le digan al gobierno exactamente cómo entraron a "Imaginaciónlandia". Mientras tanto, Cartman no se da por vencido en su apuesta con Kyle.

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El Sr. Mackey es despedido de la escuela por perder una hoja de marihuana durante una presentación en contra de las drogas. Entretanto, los chicos tratan de salvar a Ike de su fiesta ''bris'' en donde le harán la circuncisión.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman ha logrado “la paz mundial” gracias a una de sus bromas para humillar a Kyle. Este acontecimiento reúne a miles de líderes religiosos de todo el mundo en South Park.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los japoneses están realizando ataques con el fin de aniquilar a todos los delfines y ballenas del planeta. Ante esta situación, Stan decide toma medidas para detener la matanza.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle se enoja con sus padres por no dejarlo ir al concierto de los Raging Pussies, y Cartman le recomienda que le diga a la policía que sus padres lo masturbaron para que los arresten.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Una apuesta iniciada porque Cartman vio a un duende es el inicio de un problema, aunado a que los chicos se encuentran frente a la totalidad imaginativa del mundo atacada por un grupo terrorista.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se considera el crítico número uno en Internet de restaurantes en South Park.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos intentan cruzar al elefante de Kyle con ''Fofa'', la cerda de Cartman, para un experimento genético de la escuela con el cual intentan ganarle a Terrance. Mientras, Stan lucha contra los abusos físicos de su hermana, Shelly.
programme.sub-title: Un elefante hace el amor con una cerda

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman consigue ganar dinero subiendo videos de unos bebés peleando por una pelotita de crack. Kyle piensa que eso es malo hasta que Cartman lo convence de que no es así.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman le insiste a sus amigos que los ataques terroristas del 11 de Septiembre fueron una conspiración y se dispone a desenmascarar la verdad. Por su parte, el Sr. Mackey quiere saber quién defecó en el baño.
programme.sub-title: El misterio del mojón en el urinal

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El Señor Garrison ha decidido hacerse un cambio de sexo y ahora se siente como una verdadera mujer. Mientras tanto, Kyle quiere hacerse una cirugía para ser negro y poder jugar en el equipo de básquetbol.
programme.sub-title: La nueva vagina del Señor Garrison

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Un día de diversión en el parque acuático se torna mortal para los niños.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Nueva Jersey se está expandiendo rápidamente y South Park está en peligro de convertirse en la siguiente ciudad en ser invadida. Randy y los chicos intentarán evitarlo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Una nueva alumna llega a la escuela primaria de South Park y es negra por lo que Cartman cree que debería hacer pareja con Token, y no dejará que nadie se interponga en el camino, en especial Kyle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos encuentran un antiguo objeto triangular en una excavación escolar. Luego de salir en el noticiero, Barbra Streisand aparece buscándolo ya que es lo que necesita para poder convertirse en un monstruo gigante japonés.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle está muy enfermo y su madre trata de curarlo con medicinas naturales de una curandera y sus colaboradores "nativos americanos”. Mientras, el señor Garrison es despedido y se convierte en un escritor de novelas románticas.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Randy propone un plan para arreglar la situación económica mundial. Mientras tanto, Stan intenta devolver una máquina para hacer margaritas, y un salvador inesperado hace el último sacrificio para resolver los problemas de todos.

programme.desc: En "Imaginaciónlandia", Stan y Butters luchan contra un ejército de fuerzas imaginarias. La Suprema Corte declara que las criaturas imaginarias no son reales y planean destruir "Imaginaciónlandia".

programme.title: Un asunto real
programme.desc: Osamu y su hijo encuentran a una niña en la calle, aterida de frío. A pesar de sobrevivir con dificultades gracias a pequeños robos, la familia es feliz, hasta que un incidente imprevisto revela un secreto que pone a prueba los lazos que les unen.

programme.title: Arcadia
programme.desc: Greta, de 12 años, es llevada a través del país por su padre, quien intenta mantener unida a su familia tras la ruptura de su matrimonio.

programme.title: Gangster Nº 1
programme.desc: Un mafioso recuerda su ascenso en el Londres de los años sesenta. La ambición y la envidia lo llevan a traicionar a su mentor, Freddie Mays, para convertirse en el gánster más temido de la ciudad.

programme.title: Manos de seda
programme.desc: Juan, un carterista de poca monta, sobrevive con pequeños encargos para Ruth, dueña de un garito de póker. Al seguir a Silvia, esposa de un ludópata, para cobrar una deuda, se verá envuelto en una situación inesperada.

programme.title: Salto al vacío
programme.desc: Alex es una chica de 20 años que se hace cargo de la manutención de su familia con el tráfico ilegal de armas. Es la única chica en un mundo de hombres, dividida entre la necesidad de encontrar el amor y una vida basada en la violencia.

programme.title: Escándalo
programme.desc: La historia sigue el romance entre una bailarina exótica y el ministro de Guerra, una relación que sacude al gobierno británico. Basada en el escándalo Profumo de 1963.

programme.title: Un mes en el campo
programme.desc: Tras la Primera Guerra Mundial, Tom Birkin llega a un pueblo del norte de Inglaterra para restaurar un antiguo mural oculto en una iglesia. Su presencia despierta el recelo del reverendo y de unos vecinos reacios a cambiar el orden establecido.

programme.title: La ola
programme.desc: El experimento de un profesor de instituto para demostrar a sus alumnos cómo es la vida bajo una dictadura se descontrola terriblemente cuando forma una unidad social con vida propia.

programme.title: Algo Prestado
programme.desc: Las amistades se ponen a prueba y los secretos salen a la luz cuando Rachel, soltera recalcitrante, se enamora de Dex, el prometido de su mejor amiga Darcy.

programme.title: La sombra del cazador
programme.desc: Un joven periodista, un cámara y un desacreditado corresponsal de guerra emprenden una misión no autorizada para encontrar al delincuente de guerra más buscado de Bosnia.

programme.title: El duodécimo hombre
programme.desc: En 1943, en la Noruega ocupada por Alemania, un grupo de saboteadores es traicionado y apresado por las tropas nazis. De los 12 integrantes del comando, sólo uno consigue sobrevivir.

programme.title: Prisioneros del sol
programme.desc: Una expedición multinacional descubre una ciudad perdida bajo una pirámide en la que tendrán que detener a los dioses del antiguo Egipto que han despertado para iniciar el apocalipsis.

programme.title: El duodécimo hombre
programme.desc: En 1943, en la Noruega ocupada por Alemania, un grupo de saboteadores es traicionado y apresado por las tropas nazis. De los 12 integrantes del comando, sólo uno consigue sobrevivir.

programme.title: Prisioneros del sol
programme.desc: Una expedición multinacional descubre una ciudad perdida bajo una pirámide en la que tendrán que detener a los dioses del antiguo Egipto que han despertado para iniciar el apocalipsis.

programme.title: El ladrón de Shanghai
programme.desc: Con la ayuda de un maestro en artes marciales, un intrépido joven se hace pasar por un príncipe llegado de un lejano país para poder casarse con la hija del Rey y aspirar al trono.

programme.title: Old Henry
programme.desc: Un granjero entrado en edad y su hijo ayudan a un forajido en problemas. Pronto, el infierno se desata.

programme.title: Vikingos
programme.desc: Finales del siglo X. Tras la muerte de su padre Sviatoslav I, gobernante de la Rus de Kiev, el joven príncipe vikingo Vladimir se ve obligado a exiliarse en el mar helado para escapar de su hermanastro traidor Yaropolk.

programme.title: CAT. 8
programme.desc: Con la esperanza de presentar un sistema de defensa global fiable, una científica desencadena un desastre magnético.

programme.title: Junglee: Alma Salvaje
programme.desc: Un veterano de guerra vuelve a casa, a la reserva de elefantes de su padre, donde tendrá que luchar contra unos cazadores furtivos.

programme.title: La boda de Rosa
programme.desc: A punto de cumplir 45 años, Rosa se da cuenta de que siempre ha vivido su vida para servir a los demás, por lo que decide dejarlo todo atrás, tomar las riendas de su vida y cumplir su sueño de emprender su propio negocio.

programme.title: Nocturna
programme.desc: ¿Qué es lo que hace a la noche tan misteriosa? ¿Qué hay detrás de todas esas pequeñas cosas que hacen a la noche ser así y que parecen no tener explicacón?

programme.title: Amigos por siempre
programme.desc: Alessandro, un pediatra viudo de cuarenta años, vive con su hijo adolescente llevando una existencia monótona. Todos, amigos y familiares, lo instan a salir y encontrar un nuevo amor. ¡Será una llamada telefónica desde Brasil que cambiará su vida!

programme.title: Atrapada en San Valentin
programme.desc: Después de la peor cita de San Valentín de su vida, Katherine vuelve de camino a su casa cuando una gitana le lanza un hechizo. A la mañana siguiente, se dará cuenta de que está reviviendo el mismo día.

programme.title: Crónicas diplomáticas
programme.desc: El Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores contrata al joven Arthur Vlaminck como encargado del “lenguaje”. En otras palabras, redactará los discursos del ministro.

programme.title: Un tipo de altura
programme.desc: El "largo" Dexter King, tímido y torpe, es el hombro de un comediante que trabaja en Drury Lane. Alérgico a las plumas, Dexter, a quien un médico le ha recetado una serie de inyecciones, conoce a la enfermera Kate y se enamora de ella.

programme.title: Donkey Xote
programme.desc: Rucio, el burro de Sancho Panza, decide contar la historia de Don Quijote. De hecho Rucio insiste en que el caballero no está tan loco y fuera de lo común como muchos piensan.

programme.title: Crónicas diplomáticas
programme.desc: El Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores contrata al joven Arthur Vlaminck como encargado del “lenguaje”. En otras palabras, redactará los discursos del ministro.

programme.title: Lotoman 003
programme.desc: Miguel y Modesto Marchena están de vuelta en la pobreza. Un enfrentamiento con un par de ciclistas ladrones los convierte en héroes locales y los pone en contacto con una agencia secreta que los recluta para una tarea.

programme.title: Los Fabulosos Má Mejores
programme.desc: Un equipo dominicano de béisbol infantil y su entrenador loco deben encontrar una manera de usar su encanto y habilidades para recaudar los fondos necesarios para competir en el primer Torneo de Béisbol de la Liga Pequeña y ganar el campeonato.

programme.title: Red Dog, una historia de lealtad
programme.desc: Basada en una historia real, la película cuenta cómo un perro recorre Australia creando vínculos con los habitantes de un pueblo minero, convirtiéndose en un símbolo de amistad y lealtad.

programme.title: Puntos extra por asesinato
programme.desc: Maisy se traslada a la universidad de su difunta hermana para investigar las circunstancias de su muerte.

programme.title: Mi obsesión por Rachel
programme.desc: Rachel inicia una relación con Craig, un hombre encantador que irrumpe en su vida con un romanticismo inesperado. Todo parece perfecto… hasta que su verdadera personalidad comienza a salir a la luz.

programme.title: The Guilty Ones
programme.desc: La hija de BAI fue secuestrada y murió accidentalmente hace diez años, el oficial Chen le prometió atrapar al criminal pero se retiró sin ningún resultado.

programme.title: Fría como un diamante
programme.desc: El inspector Klute investiga la desaparición de una gran cantidad de joyas para la empresa que las tenía aseguradas. Con la ayuda de la hija del mafioso que cometió el robo, Klute intenta recuperar el botín.

programme.title: 23-F: El día más difícil del Rey
programme.desc: El 23 de febrero de 1981, un grupo de mandos militares encabezados por Antonio Tejero perpetraron un intento de golpe de Estado durante la votación del candidato a la presidencia del Gobierno, Leopoldo Calvo Sotelo, en el Congreso.

programme.title: Redada mortal
programme.desc: Un hábil luchador es contratado para neutralizar al equipo de seguridad de una fábrica local y permitir que su empleador extorsione a su poderoso dueño.

programme.title: El asesinato de John Lennon

When new twists and clues begin to emerge, the world's greatest sleuth and his trusted assistant must now use their legendary wits and ingenious methods to catch the killer before the queen becomes the next victim.

They're shocked to discover that their mother lied about his death because she never knew who the biological father was. programme.desc: The unthinkable happens when heavily armed and highly trained terrorists launch a bold daytime attack on the White House. The building is overrun, and President Benjamin Asher (Aaron Eckhart) and his staff are taken hostage. Luckily for Asher, former presidential security officer Mike Banning (Gerard Butler) is on the scene. With time running out, it's up to Banning to locate Asher's son before the extremists do and rescue the president before his captors unleash their ultimate plan.

programme.title: Triple 9
programme.desc: Bullets fly on the Atlanta freeway as armed thieves make their getaway following a bank robbery in broad daylight. Unhappy with the results, ruthless gangster Irina Vlaslov orders the men to pull off another job. One member of the team is Marcus Belmont (Anthony Mackie), a crooked cop who gets saddled with Chris Allen (Casey Affleck), his new but incorruptible police partner. As Belmont and his cohorts lay the groundwork for the heist, they come up with a devious plan to use Allen as their pawn.

programme.title: Brooklyn's Finest
programme.desc: A drug operation changes the lives of three conflicted New York cops. Burned-out vet Eddie Dugan is close to retirement; narcotics cop Sal Procida faces the difficult task of caring for his large family on his ordinary salary. Undercover officer Clarence Tango Butler finds his loyalties beginning to shift toward a powerful drug dealer. Over seven chaotic days, the three men are drawn toward a fateful crime and destiny.

programme.title: Mr. Pawsitively Perfect
programme.desc: An aspiring marketing designer's favorite foster dog is adopted by a famous, but down-on-his-luck furniture designer, whom she fears only wants the dog for his new image.

programme.title: Wedding Cake Dreams
programme.desc: A woman who put a piece of wedding cake under her pillow as a girl hoping to dream of her future husband, goes home to her sister's wedding and learns that the best man is the “man of her dreams.”

programme.title: A Match for the Prince

Through stages of shock, disbelief and anger -- and with support from her son -- Grace ultimately regains her footing while learning it's never too late to be happy.

programme.desc: On a mission to protect Earth, the battle-scarred and broken Bumblebee is found and repaired by a teenager named Charlie. They must work together to save the planet from the evil Decepticons in this action-packed adventure for the whole family.

programme.title: Aeon Flux
programme.desc: Academy Award-winner Charlize Theron stars as Aeon Flux, the underground operative fighting totalitarian rule in 25th-century Earth's last living city.

programme.title: Ghost In The Shell (2017)
programme.desc: Major (Scarlett Johansson) is the first of her kind, a human mind inside an artificial body. Discovering her creators lied about her past life to control her, Major will stop at nothing to unravel the mystery of her true identity and exact revenge.

programme.title: Hercules (2014)
programme.desc: The most towering myth of all time meets up with the mission of a real man in this action-adventure thriller that reveals the famed symbol of courage as he's never been seen before: finding the hero's heart that beats beneath his colossal image.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement
programme.desc: Col. Terry Childers (Samuel L. Jackson) is a 30-year Marine veteran: a decorated officer with combat experience in Vietnam, Beirut and Desert Storm -- a patriot, a hero. But now, the country he served so well has put him on trial for a rescue mission that went terribly wrong. For his attorney, he has chosen Marine Col. Hays Hodges (Tommy Lee Jones), a comrade-in-arms who owes his life to Childers.

programme.title: Defiance
programme.desc: In 1941, Nazi soldiers are slaughtering Eastern European Jews by the thousands. Three brothers, Tuvia (Daniel Craig), Zus (Liev Schreiber) and Asael (Jamie Bell), manage to escape and take refuge in the forest where they played in childhood. Seeking a way to avenge the deaths of their loved ones, the brothers turn their daily struggle for survival into a battle against the Nazis. As news of their exploits spreads, others join the fray, willing to risk their lives for even brief freedom.

programme.title: Overlord
programme.desc: On the eve of D-Day, American paratroopers drop behind enemy lines to penetrate the walls of a fortified church and destroy a radio transmitter. As the soldiers approach their target, they soon begin to realize that there's more going on in the Nazi-occupied village than a simple military operation. Making their way to an underground lab, the outnumbered men stumble upon a sinister experiment that forces them into a vicious battle against an army of the undead.

programme.title: The Marine 6: Close Quarters
programme.desc: Two former Marines, join forces to rescue a kidnapped girl from a gang of international criminals.

programme.title: The Beast
programme.desc: An emotionally charged war story that pits Soviet soldiers against Afghan rebels.

programme.title: Company Of Heroes
programme.desc: Set during WW II, follows US military units during the Battle of Normandy and the Allied liberation of France.

programme.title: Ike: Countdown To D-Day
programme.desc: A study of the days leading up to the Normandy invasion through the eyes of Eisenhower and Winston Churchill.

programme.title: The Cockleshell Heroes
programme.desc: Maj. Stringer (Jose Ferrer) needs to assemble a crack squad of British Royal Marines for a highly unusual mission. Though Capt. Thompson (Trevor Howard) is extremely skeptical, he dutifully helps his new superior recruit and train the needed men. Their audacious plan involves transporting a small group of soldiers by submarine to the coast of occupied France, where they will kayak along an estuary into a Nazi shipyard and commit sabotage. Chances for success are very small.

programme.title: Operation Mad Ball
programme.desc: Posted in France, Pvt. Hogan (Jack Lemmon) falls hard for Betty Bixby (Kathryn Grant), a nurse who happens to be a lieutenant, which means they are forbidden to fraternize due to their ranks. Always one to skirt the rules, Hogan, with the help of his friend Cpl. Bohun (Dick York), cooks up a scheme to throw a clandestine ball for all the soldiers and nurses. But the two have their work cut out for them when the authoritative Capt. Paul Lock (Ernie Kovacs) starts breathing down their necks.

programme.title: The Mouse That Roared
programme.desc: When the tiny nation of Grand Fenwick's only export, a special wine, begins to be produced in California, their entire economy collapses. Things look dire until Prime Minister Rupert Mountjoy (Peter Sellers) points out that no country that has declared war on the United States has ever gone hungry. When Field Marshall Tully Bascombe (Peter Sellers) and the 23 other men in the Grand Fenwick army invade the United States, their plan to immediately surrender unravels.

programme.title: There's Something About a Soldier
programme.desc: Wally Williams (Tom Neal) and Frank Molloy (Bruce Bennett) are friends at an officers' school. Tension builds between them when they befriend Carol Harkness (Evelyn Keyes), a secretary at the school. While both men vie for Carol's affections, Wally alienates himself from the rest of the squad with his brashness. He has a change of heart when Carol tells him about Frank's heroic military service. He alters his behavior and wins Carol's heart in the process.

programme.title: The Brady Bunch Movie
programme.desc: Mike and Carol have just one week to come up with $20,000 in back taxes, or they'll lose their house to a neighbor. Even worse, Marcia gets a swollen nose on date night, Cindy's addicted to tattling, and Jan's hearing a psychotic inner voice.

programme.title: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad!
programme.desc: Leslie Nielsen stars as Police Squad's own granite-jawed, rock-brained cop Frank Drebin, who bumbles across a mind-control scheme to assassinate Queen Elizabeth.

programme.title: Zoolander
programme.desc: Three-time male model of the year, Derek Zoolander, is devastated when he loses the title to newbie Hansel. After the news, Mugatu's fashion empire brainwashes Derek into being an assassin.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: Nearly 20 years after the cult TV show Galaxy Quest was canceled, the cast is asked for help by an alien species to save the universe.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Doom
programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

programme.title: Snow White and the Huntsman
programme.desc: Queen Ravenna (Charlize Theron), who seized control of her kingdom by marrying and killing its rightful ruler, needs the life force of young maidens to maintain her beauty. However, to become truly immortal, Ravenna must consume the heart of her stepdaughter Snow White (Kristen Stewart). Snow escapes, and Ravenna dispatches a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) to capture her. But Snow, the Huntsman and a rebel army join forces to destroy Ravenna and restore the balance of life and death.

programme.title: The Wolfman
programme.desc: Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy.

programme.title: Guardians
programme.desc: A team of former Soviet superheroes, assembled during the Cold War to combat a dangerous scientist, is dispatched against destructive robots.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: The Ron Clark Story
programme.desc: In his small North Carolina hometown, Ron Clark (Matthew Perry) leads a comfortable life as a successful elementary school teacher, earning the respect of the community. However, he knows there are students elsewhere who need him more. Following his inner calling, Clark uproots to New York City, hoping to make a difference for the disenfranchised youths the school system has left behind. Clark makes it his mission to turn around the worst students, even though he knows his job is on the line.

programme.title: Judy Moody and the NOT Bummer Summer
programme.desc: Judy (Jordana Beatty) has planned the most awesome summer ever and can't wait to have adventures with her best friends, Rocky and Amy. Then she finds out that Rocky is off to tame lions and that Amy is flying to Borneo with her mother to save a lost tribe. Judy is bummed to be left home with her rotten brother, Stink (Parris Mosteller), and her second-best friend, Frank Pearl. And, what's worse, her parents go to California and leave her with an aunt (Heather Graham) she's never even met.

programme.title: Romantic Friction
programme.desc: Artist Lea pretends to be the author of a hit romance novel written by Michael, leading to love.

programme.title: Love's Secret Ingredient
